function.name: stripe_sync
function.description: Reconcile Stripe products + prices from a declared YAML catalog. Idempotent. Defaults to dry-run; --apply hits the API; --prod required for live mode; --write-env merges resolved price IDs into .env. One-command alternative to clicking through the Stripe dashboard.

config.description: Path to the YAML catalog file. Defaults to /opt/aria/config/stripe_products.yaml.

apply.description: Apply changes against Stripe. If false, runs as dry-run and prints the diff. Defaults to false.

prod.description: Required when the YAML config sets mode=live. Refuses to hit the live API without this explicit flag. Safety gate.

write_env.description: Merge resolved {env_var: price_id} pairs back into /opt/aria/.env. Requires apply=true.
